name: Human Genome Project completion announcement
short_desc: The Human Genome Project (HGP) was an international scientific research project with the goal of determining the base pairs that make up human DNA, and of identifying, mapping and sequencing all of the genes of the human genome from both a physical and a functional standpoint.
date_note: 2003 dates the Human Genome Project’s completion announcement. The draft was published in 2001; gapless reference assemblies came later.
